SolanaProx-AI 1.0.1 is a major update focused on expanded model support and improved onboarding.

- Now supports 19 AI models across 5 providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Together.ai, Mistral, and Google.
- Simplified Solana-native payment flow and wallet-native authentication using the `SOLANAPROX_WALLET_ADDRESS` environment variable.
- Dropped API keys/accounts — now strictly pay-per-inference with USDC on Solana.
- Offers drop-in compatibility with OpenAI SDKs via the `solanaprox-openai` package.
- Enhanced documentation: full model table, use cases, orchestration flow, and explicit security/trust statements.

Major update: Adds agent automation and modernizes API documentation.

- Introduced demo showing how an autonomous agent finds SolanaProx and pays for AI inference without human input
- Updated API reference, including a new balance endpoint and example responses
- Refined setup instructions for better clarity
- Expanded ecosystem section with demo repository and registry info
- Minor tag and copy improvements for accuracy and discoverability

- Initial release of SolanaProx-AI enables pay-per-use AI inference via Solana USDC.
- Connect your Phantom wallet for instant access—no accounts or API keys required.
- Supports Claude Sonnet and GPT-4 Turbo models with per-call pricing ($0.003/call).
- Real-time deposit detection through Helius WebSockets and balance linked to your wallet.
- Designed for both users and autonomous agents; works worldwide with no minimum deposit.
- Full API reference and desktop integration instructions included.
